artifacts.title: Review: Todos can have a due date
artifacts.markdown:
Approved. Validation sits in the POST handler, as the plan says. `isIsoDate` uses the regex plus the toISOString round trip, so it rejects 2026-02-30 and 2026-13-01. A missing or null `dueDate` is stored as null, and `Todo` always carries the key. The page uses text nodes only, with no innerHTML. Tests cover valid, missing, null and bad values.

No blocking issues. Cross-ticket: EV0XEBCZ-3 (rename) and EV0XEBCZ-4 (heading count) touch the same files in other regions. One thing to watch: EV0XEBCZ-3's new `todos.test.ts` test expects `deepEqual` `{id,title,done}` and will need `dueDate: null` after both merge.

crossTicketRisks.description: EV0XEBCZ-3's test 'rename trims the title...' does a deepEqual on {id,title,done}. Once the Todo shape gains dueDate: null, that test fails after merge and needs updating. Both tickets also edit server.ts and the test files, in different regions, so conflicts should be trivial.
Both tickets edit render() in public/index.html. A small textual conflict is possible, but the changes are compatible.
Both tickets edit src/todos.ts and test/todos.test.ts in different regions. EV0XEBCZ-1's remove test uses deepEqual against objects returned by add, which still works with the new field.

payload.text:
Review is done: verdict `success`, no blocking issues. I didn't run the linter or the tests.

The diff matches the plan and every acceptance criterion:
- **Validation:** it's in the POST handler, as planned. `isIsoDate` uses the regex plus the `toISOString` round trip, so it rejects impossible dates like 2026-02-30 and 2026-13-01.
- **Missing or null `dueDate`:** it is stored as `null`, and every todo now carries the `dueDate` key.
- **Page:** it shows the due date as a text node, with no `innerHTML`.
- **Tests:** they cover valid, missing, null and bad values.

I recorded three cross-ticket warnings, none blocking:
- **EV0XEBCZ-3 (rename):** its test "rename trims the title…" does a `deepEqual` on `{id, title, done}`. After both branches merge, that test will fail and needs `dueDate: null` added.
- **EV0XEBCZ-4 (heading count):** both tickets edit `render()` in `public/index.html`, so a small merge conflict is possible. The changes are compatible.
- **EV0XEBCZ-1 (delete fix):** both edit `src/todos.ts` and `test/todos.test.ts`, in different regions. Its `remove` test still works with the new field.
